basis: The verifier is a separate module and reconstructs Markdown structure independently of the compiler.
The accepted Note reference recompiles byte-for-byte while retaining readme_inherited assurance.
A different ProductFactsV2 input compiles through the same contract without Note prose.
Cross-product identity, unverified fact use, unsupported extra badges, comments, emoji, copyright, shallow or directional Mermaid, and stale cache dependencies fail closed.
The contract does not generate product prose and therefore does not create a second agentic composition route.
limitations: This accepts the reusable structural contract only.
It does not approve a repository-verified Note, Page, PDF, or portfolio candidate.
Agentic prose quality remains independently reviewed in downstream VPY tasks.
